newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo shares gain after ADR strength.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo shares gain after ADR strength.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc rose on Thursday after a strong performance by its ADRs in the U.S. and extending yesterday's gains sparked by an upgrade by analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, traders said.

Dealers pointed out that Glaxo was currently conducting a series of presentations to fund managers following results earlier this month and ahead of a major research and development presentation in May.
"They are putting on a very confident face," said one.
The stock was up 12-1/2p at 11.14 stg by 0858 GMT in volume of 518,381 shares. In the U.S. its ADRs were up $1-1/8 at $36.
Hoare Govett on Wednesday raised Glaxo to "buy" from "undervalued" with a price target of 12.63 stg.
